title: Workshop VOC Episode During Resin Work
app: Bambu Lab printers, Prusa Connect, OctoPrint, Moonraker, LaserWeb, CNC.js, drybox sensors, and workshop telemetry via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=workshop:air
| bin _time span=1h
| stats max(voc_index) as max_voc_index by zone _time
| where max_voc_index>200
| sort - max_voc_index
description: Uses Workshop air sensors telemetry to monitor VOC spikes during messy or resin-heavy work in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for ventilation gaps that matter for operator comfort and safety, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Workshop air sensors data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Hourly VOC spike chart by zone.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates VOC spikes during messy or resin-heavy work so you can spot ventilation gaps that matter for operator comfort and safety before it becomes annoying.
